entries.text: The bundled TPC-DS `dsdgen` no longer emits invalid or duplicate item keys in web order lineitems and web returns for SF 1 and larger refresh sets. Previously the generator read past the end of its item list, so `LF_WR` maintenance inserts failed on Linux engines that enforce `NOT NULL` keys (CedarDB, DuckDB) and stored default keys elsewhere. Only the affected refresh rows change; base data and queries are unchanged.
